snippet.title: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game | Matt Mercer & Platforms Reveal
snippet.description:
We're taking on a new hire! Middle Management is thrilled to let you know that we're docking your wages even further, to bring Mr Matt Mercer on board as the voice of our eloquent Mr Magpie!

We're also announcing today, that Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game will release for Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2 in Early 2027, and coming to Game Pass on Day One!

Jump into our demo NOW on Steam as part of Steam Next Fest and get ready for PROFIT!
